summary: update-bundled checks bundled code against the latest PyPI release and requires a _BUNDLED_METADATA variable (pypi_name, version, optional version_constraints) registered in update-bundled.py.
questions: How do I fix an update-bundled sanity error?

answer_card.title: update-bundled test
answer_card.answer_md:
Errors and fixes:
- Out of date vs PyPI: update the code and the version in `_BUNDLED_METADATA`.
- Missing `_BUNDLED_METADATA`: add it.
- Not listed in the test: add the file to `get_bundled_libs()` in `update-bundled.py`.

Fields: `pypi_name`, `version`, optional `version_constraints` (PEP 440).
